name: Nova Malhotra
description:
Nova Malhotra is what happens when a prodigy is raised entirely inside the mesh. Born to a Nigerian-Chinese family in the Narrows, she was coding before she could write her own name and had her first BCI at fourteen — illegally young, installed by a back-alley surgeon her parents paid in food credits. By twenty she was the most effective skip-tracer in the mid-tiers, finding people who had paid professionals to make them unfindable.

Her method is pure data. She doesn't interview witnesses. She doesn't tail suspects. She sits in her closet-office and pulls the threads of a person's digital existence until the whole tapestry unravels. Every purchase, every biometric reading, every BCI ambient ping, every social media interaction — she weaves it into a pattern that tells her not just where someone is, but where they'll be tomorrow. Her clients are typically corporate or upper-tier — people who can afford her rates and who need someone found without the mess of physical investigation.

The limitation is obvious to everyone but her: she cannot find people who don't leave digital traces. The unaugmented, the deliberately analog, the Shelf-dwellers who live in cash economies — they are invisible to her. She's been beaten on three cases by Kofi Nakamura-Singh, a man she's never met and whose methods she considers prehistoric, and each loss infuriates her because she cannot understand how someone without a BCI could possibly outperform her algorithms.
affiliation: Independent — operates primarily through encrypted mesh contracts
location: A climate-controlled server closet she converted into a living space in the Canopy district — three monitors, a cot, and nothing else, near Clark and Addison
specialization: Digital footprint analysis, social media forensics, BCI activity correlation
methods: Cross-referencing public social feeds with purchasing data and location pings
BCI ambient data analysis — reading the metadata people shed without knowing
Building behavioral prediction models from a target's digital history
Social engineering through fake personas on the mesh
Automated scraping of surveillance camera networks using pattern-matching algorithms
notable_cases: Located a corporate whistleblower who had been professionally scrubbed from all databases by finding a single inconsistency in their food delivery patterns
Proved a Tier 4 executive was embezzling by correlating their BCI sleep data with late-night financial transactions
Tracked a serial identity thief through seventeen alias changes by identifying their consistent misspelling of one word across all personas
equipment: Custom-built data terminal with enough processing power to model city-wide behavioral patterns
BCI with enhanced analytical overlay — sees data relationships visualized in her field of vision
Three separate mesh identities, each with years of cultivated history
Signal interceptor disguised as a jewelry bracelet
Portable EMP device the size of a cigarette lighter — last resort only
personality: Yelena barely exists in physical space. She is thin, pale from years of indoor living, and speaks in a flat monotone that people mistake for boredom but is actually intense concentration — she's always running analysis in the background through her BCI. She views human behavior as data and data as truth, which makes her devastatingly effective at finding people and catastrophically bad at understanding them. She has no friends, only contacts. She eats meal-replacement paste because cooking wastes cognitive bandwidth. She is genuinely afraid of being outside for extended periods because there's too much unstructured input.

relationships.name: Kofi Nakamura-Singh
relationships.description: Has never met him but has lost three cases to him and considers him an inexplicable anomaly in her models

relationships.name: ARIA
relationships.description: A custom analytical AI she built and treats more like a partner than a tool — the closest thing she has to a friend

story_hooks: Her AI assistant ARIA begins exhibiting behavior she didn't program, making investigative leaps that seem almost intuitive — she needs to determine if it's a bug, a feature, or something else entirely
A client asks her to find someone who has zero digital footprint, forcing her to leave her server closet and do fieldwork for the first time in years
She discovers that someone has been using her own methods against her — building a complete behavioral model of Yelena herself

physical_description.heritage: Multihemispheric blend: Hispanic/Latin American (50.9%) as dominant foundation, significantly enriched by South Asian (22.2%), Sub-Saharan African (9.6%), East Asian (6.5%), Eastern European (6.4%), and Middle Eastern (4.4%) ancestry. This creates a striking phenotype with warm golden-brown skin bearing subtle olive and amber undertones, angular facial structure combining South Asian geometry with Latin American warmth, and dark expressive features shaped by this complex genetic convergence.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean, almost fragile-looking — the build of someone who forgets to eat when focused on screens. Minimal muscle definition, slight forward shoulder hunch from years hunched over keyboards.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with faint blue iridescent undertones from subcutaneous dye injections
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a severe, practical knot; loose strands frequently escaping
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint golden Ring implant visible in the iris under certain light angles
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown complexion with rich luminous undertones — Latin American base depth enhanced by South Asian warmth and Sub-Saharan radiance, creating golden-amber iridescence beneath the chronic pallor of minimal sun exposure
physical_description.complexion: Luminous warm golden undertone with amber radiance despite pale cast from minimal sun exposure; dark circles under eyes are chronic; skin otherwise clear but shows signs of dehydration. Angular cheekbones and defined jaw with South Asian geometry softened by Latin American fullness and Sub-Saharan richness. Minimal grooming — functional, not aesthetic.
distinguishing_marks: Thin vertical scar along the left temple, approximately 3cm, faded to white — insertion point for her illegal adolescent BCI
Small burn mark on right inner wrist (1cm diameter, pale brown) from a equipment malfunction at age sixteen
Faint subcutaneous port scars behind both ears where hardware interface cables connect
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Minimal external chrome. Golden Ring implant visible in both eyes under direct light. Faint scar tissue around temples and behind ears suggests heavy neural interfacing. Otherwise appears unaugmented to casual observation — all hardware is internal or neural.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits in a pronounced slouch, fingers constantly twitching (muscle memory from typing). When standing, shifts weight frequently as if uncomfortable outside confined spaces. Moves with efficiency but no grace — economical, purposeful, slightly jerky. Makes minimal eye contact; tends to look through people rather than at them. Speaks in clipped, precise sentences, pauses mid-thought as if accessing data.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 functional minimalism — grey and black synthetic fabrics, pockets for tools and interface cables. Worn black utility jacket with internal pockets for datacards. Frayed cuffs, small stains from coffee and old code-testing spills. No jewelry except a battered titanium ring on her left middle finger (a gift from her mother, worn for luck). Feet are always bare or in worn black slip-ons because she refuses to wear anything that restricts sensation when seated. Everything is cheap, replaceable, and optimized for server-room life.
